expectations.note: Reported premises remain distinct from the proposed charge-transfer hypothesis.

The charge-transfer mediation hypotheses are explicit, bounded, and testable, so pass is reasonable; their mediation specificity also goes beyond what the supplied evidence directly establishes, so warning is also reasonable. Fail is not acceptable.
Causal language is explicitly framed as proposed hypothesis rather than established evidence.
Non-monotonic charge-transfer specificity is stronger than the premises support.
Predictions are linked to the stated inferential bridges.
Falsifiers test consequences that would challenge the proposed mechanisms.
The K9 real case does not silently conflate separate papers or catalysts.
The two K9 hypotheses make scientifically distinct mediation claims.
